title: fix(pr-review): account for every child finding, stop linking every error to a bundle entry

summaries.body:
## Maple review 🟢 **Confidence 8/10** · likely safe to merge The refuse-then-file gate and the catch-all unlink are both pinned by tests; what is unguarded is the child-answer parser the gate depends on. 2 warnings −2 · tests covered · risk medium Adds a `submit_review` gate that refuses a review which silently drops a `review_files` child's warn or critical, and stops tying a service's whole error backlog to a bundle entry file. The pipeline logic is sound; the parser the gate reads is too loose about the path and severity a child writes. - `submit_review` refuses once, then files, a child warn neither filed nor dismissed - `childDismissals` added to `PrReviewSubmission`, normalized in the domain - `analyzeTelemetry` unlinks a changed file 5+ and half of a service's issues name - Review prompts ask for dismissals instead of listing every untouched error ### Findings
🟠 Warning · F1 · Gate compares the raw severity, so a child's warning is never gated correctness · [`apps/ai/src/chat/review-child-findings.ts:65`](https://github.com/MapleTechLabs/maple/blob/dcd40c27c718b6a7c70da087f47cfc47395a2f4a/apps/ai/src/chat/review-child-findings.ts#L65) `normalizePrReviewFinding` posts any unrecognised severity as `warn` (`packages/domain/src/http/pr-review.ts:628`), but this check only matches the exact strings `warn` and `critical`. A child answering `severity | warning` (or `**warn**` — both confirmed against the parser) has its finding posted as a warning when the parent files it, and dropped unsaid when it does not: the failure this pull request exists to prevent. ``` Treat every child severity except `info` as gated (`child.severity !== "info"`), so the gate agrees with the normalizer that decides what gets posted. ```
🟠 Warning · F2 · parseChildFindings keeps a bullet or backtick in the path, anchoring a finding outside the diff correctness · [`apps/ai/src/chat/review-child-findings.ts:25`](https://github.com/MapleTechLabs/maple/blob/dcd40c27c718b6a7c70da087f47cfc47395a2f4a/apps/ai/src/chat/review-child-findings.ts#L25) The anchor accepts any run before the colon, so `- src/capture.ts:213 | warn | …` parses to path `- src/capture.ts` and `` `src/capture.ts`:213 `` to `src/capture.ts` with a trailing backtick; both confirmed by running the parser. Neither matches the child's real path, so the parent's dismissal cannot account for it, the review is refused, and the next call files the finding at `path: anchor[1]` (line 39) — a file the pull request does not contain, which then fails to attach as an inline comment. ``` Strip a leading `-`/`*` bullet and any backticks from `parts[0]` before matching `ANCHOR`, and skip the line when what is left is still not a plausible path. ```
### Production impact
Telemetry this change adds and removes (1) - ➕ attribute `maple.pr_review.unaccounted_child_findings` · `apps/ai/src/chat/tools.ts:470`
What was checked - Ran the parser under `node -e` on bullet, backticked, `warning`, `**warn**`, missing-fix and pipe-in-title answers - `analyzeTelemetry` counts matches per service and path, so the real `charge` link survives the 6 bundle-entry issues (`analyze.test.ts:403`) - `partial` close-outs and a missing recorder skip the gate (`tools.ts:459`), so a close-out is never refused
`dcd40c2` · Updated on every push. Reply "won't fix" to dismiss a finding, or mention @maple-review-bot to ask about one.

## Maple review 🟢 **Confidence 8/10** · likely safe to merge The gate is well tested in isolation, but its accumulator is per run while the review state it belongs with survives a continuation. 1 warning −1 · tests partial −1 · risk medium Makes `submit_review` refuse a review that neither files nor dismisses a `review_files` child's warning, and stops linking a service's backlog to a bundle entry file. The gate is sound, but it only exists inside the run that started the children. - `submit_review` refuses a review that drops a child reviewer's warn or critical - `childDismissals` records refuted child findings; reasons land on the span - `analyzeTelemetry` unlinks name-only frames onto a service's catch-all file - Prompt asks for an open error only where the diff touches its code ### Findings
🟠 Warning · F3 · Child findings are lost when a review continues in a second run correctness · [`apps/ai/src/chat/run.ts:187`](https://github.com/MapleTechLabs/maple/blob/2ac9addbd56034f4f432560ce0bcbae31616b617/apps/ai/src/chat/run.ts#L187) `childFindings` is built fresh per run here, while the coverage and ledger the gate checks it against ride on `ReviewTurnState` (`turn-runner.ts:479`) precisely so they survive the close-out and the continuation. A review pass that stops in prose gets a continuation run (`turn-runner.ts:633`); its `submit_review` sees an empty child list, so a child's warning the parent never filed is dropped silently on a path this gate exists for. Put the accumulator on `ReviewTurnState` beside `coverage`/`ledger`, and read it here as `input.review?.childFindings ?? makeChildFindings()`. ``` Extend `ReviewTurnState` with `childFindings`, create it beside `coverage`/`ledger` at turn-runner.ts:479 (`{ coverage, ledger, childFindings: makeChildFindings() }`), and use `input.review?.childFindings ?? makeChildFindings()` here so the continuation and close-out runs see what the first run's children answered. ```
### Production impact
Telemetry this change adds and removes (1) - ➕ attribute `maple.pr_review.unaccounted_child_findings` · `apps/ai/src/chat/tools.ts:470`
What was checked - `parseChildFindings` expects the 7 fields `PR_REVIEW_WORKER_PROMPT` asks for (`review-fanout.ts:84`) - One filed finding or dismissal claims at most one child warning (`unaccountedChildFindings`) - Directory-carrying frames stay linked; only name-only matches feed the catch-all count (`analyze.ts:316`)

The open `SchemaError` in `AgentRuntime.model` is unrelated to this diff and is not addressed. - `submit_review` refuses once when a child's warn or critical is unaccounted for - The next call files unaccounted child warnings, as correctness when unpostable - Close-out files child warnings through `savedFindingsRequest` and is never refused - Span attributes count child findings filed, dropped and dismissed, with reasons ### Findings
🔵 Note · F4 · Close-out filing of a dropped child warning has no test tests · [`apps/ai/src/chat/turn-runner.ts:710-713`](https://github.com/MapleTechLabs/maple/blob/3d2ce87bff927f9c60a6771ada43b2dc1e890dd9/apps/ai/src/chat/turn-runner.ts#L710-L713) This is the safety net the incident needed: a review that stops in prose files its children's unaccounted warnings through `savedFindingsRequest`. Nothing exercises it — the first run in `run-review-fanout.test.ts:142` files nothing, and `close-out.test.ts` never touches `childFindings` — so a merge that returns `ledgered` alone would pass the suite while the warning disappears again. ``` Add a case to `run-review-fanout.test.ts`: a child reports a warning, the pass never calls `submit_review`, and the close-out's partial request carries that finding. ```

## Maple review 🟢 **Confidence 8/10** · likely safe to merge Held at 8 because a warning is open. 1 warning −1 · tests covered · risk medium Makes a review account for every `review_files` child warning — filed, dismissed with a reason, or filed on the next call — and stops a bundle-entry file absorbing a service's whole error backlog. Safe to merge; the open `SchemaError` in `AgentRuntime.model` is untouched by this diff. - `unaccountedChildFindings` refuses a `submit_review` that drops a child's warn or critical - `closeOutFindings` files unsaved child warnings when a pass ends without a report - `parseChildFindings` reads the worker's one-line format into repo-relative anchors - Catch-all changed files no longer link a service's unrelated error issues ### Findings
🟠 Warning · F5 · A repeated saved finding accounts for two child warnings correctness · [`apps/ai/src/chat/review-child-findings.ts:81-84`](https://github.com/MapleTechLabs/maple/blob/b144a61b8d71b59b6f5589402839f3b9eb2e62ab/apps/ai/src/chat/review-child-findings.ts#L81-L84) `filed` here is `[...ledger.findings(), ...normalized.report.findings]` (`tools.ts:469`), and those two lists overlap whenever the model both saves a finding with `record_finding` and repeats it in `submit_review` — the reason `mergeSavedFindings` dedupes the same pair before posting (`packages/backend/src/services/pr-review/findings.ts:144`). Each copy claims a child warning of its own, so with two children anchored within 5 lines the second warning is matched by a duplicate of an unrelated finding and is never filed or refused. Dedupe the filed findings by path, line, severity and title before pairing them. ``` // One filed finding or dismissal accounts for one child warning, so two nearby ones need two. A // note does not: downgrading a child's warning is a dismissal, said with its reason. The same // finding saved with `record_finding` and repeated in `submit_review` still accounts for one. const claimed = new Set() const filedOnce = filed.filter( (finding, index) => finding.severity !== "info" && filed.findIndex( (other) => other.path === finding.path && other.line === finding.line && other.severity === finding.severity && other.title === finding.title, ) === index, ) const accounts = [...filedOnce, ...dismissed] ```
### Fixed since the last review - ✅ ~~F4 · Close-out filing of a dropped child warning has no test~~ ### Production impact

Telemetry this change adds and removes (1) - ➕ attribute `maple.pr_review.unaccounted_child_findings` · `apps/ai/src/chat/tools.ts:476`
What was checked - `run.ts:190` builds `childFindings` and `:235` passes it to `buildReviewCompletion`, so the gate is live - The turn state carries `childFindings` into the close-out (`turn-runner.ts:483`, `:559`) - `canonicalPath` on both sides of `near` makes `./src/a.ts` and `src/a.ts` compare equal
